L29: Mix ingredients except methanol, NaHCO_{3} and Na_{2}S·9H_{2}O, bring to a boil and cool down under a stream of N_{2} gas. Add methanol to the medium and distribute into culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H_{2}-CO_{2} (4:1, v/v) gas mixture, seal with butyl rubber stoppers, and autoclave.
